title: Smooth nonincreasing cutoff profile with derivative supported in (1, A)
statement: Let A ∈ ℝ with A > 1. There is φ : ℝ → ℝ such that: φ is C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 φ); φ is nonincreasing (Antitone); 0 ≤ φ(u) ≤ 1 for every u; φ(u) = 1 for every u ≤ 1; φ(u) = 0 for every u ≥ A; φ'(u) ≤ 0 for every u; and φ'(u) ≠ 0 implies 1 < u < A. Here φ' := deriv φ is Mathlib's derivative (0 at points of non-differentiability).
lean_statement: ∀ (A : ℝ), 1 < A → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ Antitone φ ∧ (∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u ∧ φ u ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) ∧ (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) ∧ (∀ u, deriv φ u ≤ 0) ∧ (∀ u, deriv φ u ≠ 0 → 1 < u ∧ u < A)
